remedy.notes: Broadens the corpus beyond court sanctions into federal administrative procurement adjudication. GAO issues protest decisions and does not impose Rule 11 sanctions, so the outcome is an on-the-record advisement plus a compelled-response order, not a sanction; the fabricated citations did not affect the result, as both protest grounds were denied on independent merits grounds. Underlying procurement: DHS/USCIS RFP No. 70SBUR25R00000009. The secondary landing page must keep the comma-joined file numbers — the shortened form is a hard 404. Tooling note: gao.gov returns 403 to plain scripted requests behind Akamai for both bare and www hosts, so an automated link check failing on this URL is a known false negative; the asset was confirmed by hash against an independently obtained copy. Three further GAO matters cited in this decision are queued leads: KE Systems Services (B-423881), Oready, LLC (B-423524.2), and Raven Investigations & Security Consulting (B-423447) — note the Oready number differs from the one recorded in AIEL-CAND-004.
